## Problem

What user or system problem does this change solve?

## Decision

What changed, and what remains intentionally out of scope?

## Verification

List automated tests and repeatable acceptance evidence.

## Risk and rollback

Describe permissions, data, external side effects, compatibility and rollback.

## Documentation

List updated docs, contracts, ADRs or RFCs.

- [ ] I ran `./mvnw verify`, `./scripts/verify-contracts.sh` and `./scripts/verify-doc-links.sh`.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, real user data, private prompts, complete real traces or identifying information.
- [ ] External actions, if any, have explicit authority, idempotency and receipts.
